name: sakura-monorepo
description: Sakura's npm-workspaces monorepo. legacy/ is the production single-file app (index.html/hub.html) — deploy.yml builds and publishes legacy/ exclusively. A React rewrite (web/) was explored and discontinued 2026-08-31 without ever being deployed; its code was removed from main on 2026-09-21 (see docs/history/web-migration/framework-migration-plan.md — full source is still recoverable from git history at commit 02ad593dda2ac3b6bd4daf68956f474549feaae5, the last commit that included it). worker/ is a Cloudflare Worker proposed in docs/ai-hosted-vault-design.md, not yet deployed.
